command: set -e; export PYTEST_PLUGINS= PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1; cd /tmp; for phase in before after; do if [ "$phase" = before ]; then export PYTHONPATH=/runner; else export PYTHONPATH=/runner:/work; fi; for sample in 1 2 3; do python /work/benchmarks/http_retry_memory.py --output "/reports/$phase-$sample.json"; done; python /work/benchmarks/http_retry_memory.py --allocations --output "/reports/$phase-allocations.json"; done
